name: ModelEventMetadata
documentation: Reserved metadata keys identifying events emitted by an independent-model commit.

fields.name: CASCADE_SUBSTEPS
fields.documentation:
Comma-separated internal cascade substeps caused by this event. Complete Graph-change handlers observe their
 targets at those substeps' own boundaries; ordinary payload handlers retain {@link #SUBSTEP}.

fields.name: COMMIT_ID
fields.documentation: Durable idempotency identity of the model commit that emitted an event.

fields.name: SUBSTEP
fields.documentation: Ordered substep within the model commit.

methods.name: cascadeSubsteps
methods.documentation: Returns the bounded, ordered cascade references, rejecting malformed or backward references.

methods.name: readBoundary
methods.documentation: Returns the commit boundary carried by {@code metadata}, or {@code null} when it is not a Model event.

methods.name: readBoundary
methods.documentation:
Returns the Model boundary carried by a Model event, or falls back to an existing global event index.

The fallback lets events that predate Model metadata address state reconstructed from that same published event. Without migration coordination, an event without a Model mapping retains ordinary current-state behavior. A repository configured with {@code followPublishedEventMigration} may instead wait for the mapping or reject a processed event that produced none. An event index is never interpreted as a Model state index.
